title: Director of Offsite Production - Fabrication
text:
**At ACI we build our company and our culture not by counting people, but by making our people count!**

Atlantic Constructors is seeking dynamic, motivated, career minded individuals to join our expanding team! Atlantic Constructors has been recognized as an industry leader in the Mid-Atlantic Region for over 50 years.

* ***$0.00 COST FOR MEDICAL, DENTAL, SHORT TERM DISABILITYLIFE INSURANCE (EMPLOYEE ONLY) COVERAGE!***

**Role Overview:**
==================

The Director of Offsite Production is responsible for the leadership, performance, and continued growth of offsite production across company facilities. The role oversees carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication and non-volumetric prefabrication and manufacturing, including pipe racks, equipment skids, supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies. The Director establishes the operating systems, production standards, capacity, and cross-functional coordination required to deliver safe, compliant, high-quality work on schedule.

This leader is accountable for implementing improvements that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability. The Director will implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, eliminate waste and production constraints, reduce rework, and create repeatable processes that support scalable offsite manufacturing. The position works closely with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, and field operations to align production with project and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Offsite Production Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Provide enterprise leadership for pipe fabrication, prefabrication, and manufacturing operations across company facilities and approved external production partners.
* Translate backlog, project schedules, and sales forecasts into capacity plans, staffing requirements, production priorities, and facility needs.
* Establish a consistent operating cadence for production planning, readiness reviews, constraint management, performance reporting, and executive escalation.
* Develop scalable operating standards that support growth while maintaining safety, quality, cost control, and predictable delivery performance.
* Coordinate work across facilities to balance demand, available labor, equipment, and production capability.

**Pipe Fabrication Operations**
-------------------------------

* Direct carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication operations, including material receiving, cutting, beveling, fit-up, welding, inspection, testing, coating coordination, staging, and shipment.
* Ensure spool sequencing, production release, shop loading, and work packaging align with approved drawings, project priorities, and field installation requirements.
* Maintain compliance with applicable codes, specifications, welding procedures, ASME and AWS requirements, customer quality plans, and company standards.
* Improve material traceability, weld documentation, inspection records, testing status, and turnover packages for fabricated systems.

**Prefabrication and Manufacturing Operations**
-----------------------------------------------

* Lead production of non-volumetric prefabricated assemblies, including pipe racks, equipment skids, structural supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies.
* Develop repeatable production cells, workstations, tooling, fixtures, travelers, and assembly sequences that improve flow and reduce variation.
* Ensure manufacturing plans account for structural, mechanical, electrical, controls, insulation, coatings, testing, preservation, packaging, and logistics requirements, as applicable.
* Support the transition of first-of-a-kind work into stable, repeatable production through lessons learned, standardized design, and controlled process updates.

**Production Planning and Readiness**
-------------------------------------

* Establish production-readiness criteria to confirm approved drawings, bills of material, work instructions, quality requirements, tooling, materials, and labor are available before work is released.
* Partner with Engineering and VDC to improve constructability, spool and assembly breakdown, drawing release sequencing, and design for manufacturing and assembly.
* Coordinate with Procurement and material-control teams to maintain visibility to shortages, supplier commitments, receiving status, kitting, and point-of-use material availability.
* Identify production constraints early, assign recovery actions, and communicate schedule or capacity risks to Project Management and executive leadership.
* Maintain production schedules that clearly identify priorities, dependencies, resource loading, planned output, and required shipment dates.

**Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement**
-------------------------------------------------

* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability across all offsite operations.
* Implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, including 5S, standard work, value-stream mapping, visual management, cellular production, daily tiered accountability, Kaizen events, mistake-proofing, and continuous-flow principles.
* Evaluate workflows, facility layouts, material movement, staffing, tooling, and equipment utilization to identify and eliminate bottlenecks, waste, waiting, excess handling, rework, and other non-value-added activity.
* Use time studies, cycle-time analysis, workload balancing, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving to improve production performance and reduce manufacturing lead time.
* Develop and maintain standard work instructions and repeatable manufacturing processes that improve safety, quality, training effectiveness, and output predictability.
* Lead initiatives to reduce setup and changeover time, control work in process, improve material flow, and increase productive labor utilization.
* Maintain an improvement pipeline with defined owners, target benefits, implementation dates, and verified results; ensure completed improvements are standardized and sustained.
* Evaluate and implement automation, machinery, software, tooling, and manufacturing technologies that improve safety, quality, efficiency, and capacity.

**Throughput Capacity and Performance Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Establish production targets and capacity models based on takt time, cycle time, labor availability, equipment constraints, facility limits, and project demand.
* Track and improve key performance indicators such as safety performance, labor hours per spool or assembly, plan attainment, throughput, work in process, first-pass yield, rework, equipment utilization, and on-time completion and shipment.
* Develop visual dashboards and tiered performance reviews that provide timely, accurate information to supervisors, project teams, and executive leadership.
* Analyze performance gaps, determine root causes, implement corrective and preventive actions, and verify that results are sustained.
* Use production data to validate estimating assumptions, workforce plans, capital investments, and future capacity requirements.

**Supplier and External Fabrication Partner Management**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Qualify, onboard, and manage third-party fabrication and manufacturing partners when additional capacity or specialized capability is required.
* Define scopes of work, quality requirements, documentation, inspection points, schedule expectations, material responsibilities, and delivery requirements for outsourced work.
* Monitor supplier performance for safety, quality, responsiveness, cost, schedule adherence, and corrective-action closure.
* Coordinate external production with internal Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and logistics teams.

**Estimating and Preconstruction Support**
------------------------------------------

* Support Estimating and Preconstruction with production strategies, labor assumptions, production rates, facility requirements, tooling, equipment, subcontract capacity, and logistics considerations.
* Review proposed scope, drawings, specifications, and schedules to identify production risks, constructability issues, testing requirements, and opportunities for prefabrication or standardization.
* Provide fact-based labor and throughput data to improve estimate accuracy and establish achievable production commitments.
* Participate in make-or-buy decisions and recommend the most effective production approach based on capability, capacity, cost, risk, and schedule.

**Quality Safety and Delivery**
-------------------------------

* Promote a production culture in which safety, quality, and operational discipline are built into the process and are never traded for output.
* Partner with Safety and Quality leaders to establish training, inspections, hold points, audits, nonconformance controls, and corrective-action processes.
* Ensure completed work is inspected, tested, documented, preserved, packaged, and released in accordance with project and company requirements.
* Drive reduction of defects, weld repairs, material damage, punch-list items, field rework, and incomplete turnover documentation.
* Coordinate staging, loading, transportation readiness, and shipment sequencing to support safe handling and efficient field installation.

**Team Leadership and Development**
-----------------------------------

* Build and lead an accountable organization of production managers, superintendents, supervisors, planners, coordinators, and skilled craft professionals.
* Define roles, decision rights, staffing plans, performance expectations, and development paths for the offsite production team.
* Train leaders and production personnel in Lean principles, standard work, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, visual management, and data-driven decision-making.
* Develop succession plans and cross-training programs that increase workforce flexibility and reduce dependency on single points of knowledge.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, teamwork, continuous improvement, and respect for people.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, manufacturing, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience in fabrication, prefabrication, manufacturing, construction operations, or a closely related production environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated success improving production throughput, labor productivity, quality, schedule performance, and operating discipline.
* Practical experience implementing Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement systems in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of pipe fabrication, welding, structural fabrication, production planning, material control, quality systems, and shop operations.
* Ability to build capacity plans, interpret production data, identify constraints, and translate performance information into corrective action.
* Experience coordinating with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, suppliers, and field teams.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, financial, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple facilities and competing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent formal training in Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Experience with ASME, AWS, weld-quality programs, fabrication codes, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Experience with production-planning, ERP, manufacturing execution, scheduling, and performance-dashboard systems.
* Working knowledge of fabrication and detailing platforms such as Stratus, Tekla, SpoolFab, or comparable systems.
* Experience establishing or expanding multi-facility prefabrication and manufacturing operations.
* Experience implementing automation, advanced tooling, production-line design, and capital improvement projects
